channel.title: Crypto Readout
channel.description: Crypto Readout reports on Bitcoin, Ethereum and altcoin markets, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, network upgrades and crypto regulation worldwide.

item.title: NEAR governance backs 24-month issuance cut to 1.6%
item.description: NEAR’s House of Stake approved a 24-month cut in maximum annual issuance from 2.5% to 1.6%; validators must still adopt an upgrade before it takes effect.

item.title: NEAR approves a two-year path to 1.6% issuance
item.description: NEAR's House of Stake approved a plan to lower annual issuance from 2.5% to 1.6% over two years, but validators must still adopt the upgrade.

item.title: Binance reopens more withdrawals after $6.3B breach
item.description: Binance began reopening withdrawals for more crypto assets on Nov. 3 after a $6.3 billion wallet breach, restoring access network by network as checks clear.

item.title: How Slippage Tolerance Sets the Floor for Treasury Swaps on Base
item.description: Slippage tolerance sets the minimum tokens a treasury swap may deliver on Base; understand the quote, pool depth and execution limit before approving a trade.

item.title: DTCC Launches Token Service for Securities Held at DTC
item.description: DTCC has launched a service for turning eligible securities held at DTC into wallet-based tokens, with 20 firms signed up and transfers initially limited.

item.title: Binance Suspends Withdrawals After $6.3B Wallet Breach
item.description: Binance says attackers took about $6.3 billion from hot wallets, prompting a withdrawal suspension and a phased restart as it secures systems and covers losses.

item.title: FBI links $6bn Binance theft to North Korea
item.description: The FBI says North Korea’s TraderTraitor group stole more than $6 billion from Binance, while tracing laundering through Ethereum and urging firms to block funds.

item.title: FBI links $6bn Binance theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor
item.description: The FBI says North Korea stole more than $6 billion from Binance on Oct. 29, naming TraderTraitor and urging crypto firms to block addresses used to move funds.

item.title: SpookySwap: how swaps, bridges and liquidity positions work
item.description: SpookySwap combines pool-based swaps, cross-chain transfers and liquidity rewards; the right sequence depends on network, pool depth, bridge route and position range.

item.title: ICE and Trade[XYZ] plan US market for Hyperliquid perps
item.description: ICE and Trade[XYZ] agreed to bring Hyperliquid-based perpetual markets into a US regulated structure, with ICE running trading and clearing if approvals come.

item.title: Binance investigates security issue after $2.54 billion frozen
item.description: Binance suspended deposits and withdrawals as it investigates a possible breach; token issuers and crypto firms say they froze $2.54 billion in related assets.

item.title: Ripple wins final OCC approval for national trust bank
item.description: Ripple says the OCC has given its national trust bank final approval, putting RLUSD reserve management and institutional crypto custody under federal supervision.

item.title: Ripple says OCC gave its trust bank final approval
item.description: Ripple says its national trust bank won final OCC approval to manage RLUSD reserves and provide custody, while RLUSD issuance stays with its New York-regulated unit.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin rewards open to crypto exchanges
item.description: The OCC’s GENIUS Act rule bars stablecoin issuers from paying holders directly but leaves exchanges room to offer rewards, subject to case-by-case review.

item.title: Ethereum postpones Glamsterdam test over contract risk
item.description: Ethereum postponed Glamsterdam’s Hoodi test after developers flagged how new gas rules may change failure handling in existing contracts, with no new date set.

item.title: OCC leaves crypto platforms room to pay stablecoin rewards
item.description: The OCC's GENIUS Act rule bars stablecoin issuers from paying holders interest but leaves crypto platforms room to share reserve earnings as customer rewards.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms transaction finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing its validator voting system with certificate-based consensus that targets near-instant transaction finality.

item.title: FINMA approves Switzerland’s first retail Bitcoin ETF
item.description: FINMA has approved a Swiss retail fund that holds Bitcoin directly, creating a new fund-law route for investors while requiring custody controls and risk disclosures.

item.title: Uniswap v4 adds outside liquidity on three chains
item.description: Uniswap’s v4 aggregator hooks went live on Ethereum, Base and Robinhood Chain, routing swaps across outside liquidity and directing protocol fees toward UNI burns.

item.title: OCC rule leaves stablecoin rewards to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC’s final stablecoin rule keeps the issuer yield ban but leaves platform rewards to case-by-case review, preserving room for exchanges while setting no safe harbor.
